name: Content Probe
summary: Reports what a fenced code block actually contained, byte for byte.
description: A discovery tool, not a useful module: `probe` describes the input it received (byte length, character count, UTF-16 unit count, and counts of control, bidi-override and zero-width characters) instead of doing anything with it. `reflect` echoes it back unchanged. Built to find the edges of what real, user-typed content can carry through a fenced code block into a module.
author: slim-m

permissions.name: Use Content Probe
permissions.description: Run the content probe in this space.

extension_points.name: probe
extension_points.description: Describe the input's bytes, chars and character classes.
